title: Local resolution of the powered parameter quotient
statement: Under the hypotheses of the parent parameter-quotient statement, for any finitely presented quotient C/JC over R/J and any compatible quotient map γ₀ with quotient prime q₀ contracting to q, the canonical localization of γ₀ at q₀ is Popescu resolvable. This asserts no global quotient resolution.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07FE (lemma-resolve-special), final powered-parameter reduction

proof.text: Obtain flatness of the reduced local map and an ind-smooth closed fiber from parameter_quotient_local_flat_fiber_data. This result is independent of C and γ₀.

Prove nilpotence of the base maximal ideal in the private Lean helper powered_parameter_base_nilpotent. The mapped origin ideal is maximal in the powered polynomial quotient and lies in its nilradical because each variable has zero (8c)-th power. Every prime contains the nilradical, so any prime of this quotient equals that mapped origin ideal. Noetherian finite generation gives a nilpotence exponent for this prime, and localization maps its power to zero. Apply popescu_lift_nilpotent to the reduced local map and its maximal ideal.

Factor the localized tensor-product map through a smooth algebra using the proved independent-universe factorization lemma. Finite type supplies a finite polynomial surjection and hence a representative in Type(max u v). Transport the factorization and smoothness to Shrink of the stage.

The smooth stage has singular ideal top: its localization at 1 is smooth, so 1 belongs to the spanning ideal. Its extended radical ideal is consequently top, which contains the starting ideal and is not contained in the local maximal ideal. The composite map equality follows from the stage factorization and the inverse equivalences. This is precisely a Popescu resolution.

theorem parameter_quotient_local_resolution
    {k : Type u} {C : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing C] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    (d c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C]
    [FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C]
    (γ : letI := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra; C →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin d) k] Λ)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ) [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦
      algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)))) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))
    (hsep : IsSeparableExtension k q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    letI := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    let J : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) :=
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦ (MvPolynomial.X i ^ c) ^ 8))
    let J_C := Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C) J
    let J_Λ := Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) Λ) J
    ∀ (_ : FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J) (C ⧸ J_C))
      (γ₀ : (C ⧸ J_C) →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J] (Λ ⧸ J_Λ))
      (q₀ : PrimeSpectrum (Λ ⧸ J_Λ)),
      γ₀.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_C) =
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ).comp γ.toRingHom →
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ) q₀ = q →
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver
      (q₀.asIdeal.under (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J)) q₀.asIdeal
    CanBePopescuResolved
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift
        (Algebra.ofId (Localization.AtPrime (q₀.asIdeal.under (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J)))
          (Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal))
        ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J) (Λ ⧸ J_Λ)
          (Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal)).comp γ₀)
        (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _))
      ⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal), inferInstance⟩
